title: Houston's Climate History and Outlook
description:
This video explores Houston's climate history and outlook, including its unique climate, extreme weather events, and projected changes under different emissions scenarios. It discusses the city's vulnerability to flooding, heat, and drought, and highlights the importance of understanding and adapting to climate change. The video is based on the report "Houston's Climate Future" and provides a comprehensive overview of the city's climate situation.
